PG - 2015 External Candidates Discrepancy In Documents
Tuesday, 31 March 2015
6750 Hits
We have received your application towards admission for PG course 2015-2016. After the scrutiny of the applications and certificates it was found that some of the students have not submitted the correct certificates and some of the students have not submitted the required certificates. Therefore all are advised to see the attached document showing deficiency of his/her certificates and submit the required certificates in person on 10th April 2015 in the dean’s office.
Students are also directed to acknowledge receipt of this email.
Discrepancy List
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
